name: Effective Range / Proper Unlabeled Sample Compression
details: Proposed bound for finite concept classes; not currently established here. The former retain-all-active-examples argument passed their observed labels to the decoder and therefore proves only a proper labeled bound. An unlabeled decoder does not receive those labels. A valid replacement proof or counterexample is required; no refutation of this inequality is claimed. The benchmark gap below remains valid independently of the proposed universal bound.
witness_verification: For the $n$ singletons together with the empty concept, effective range is $n$ while proper unlabeled sample compression size is 1.
